Bill.BriefDescription: Permitting the lawful carry of firearms on snowmobiles.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permitting the lawful carry of firearms onsnowmobiles; and amending RCW 46.10.495.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.10.495 and 2003 c 53 s 234 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) No person shall operate a snowmobile in such a way as toendanger human life. (2) No person shall operate a snowmobile in such a way as to rundown or harass deer, elk, or any wildlife, or any domestic animal, norshall any person ((carry any loaded weapon upon, nor)) hunt from((,))any snowmobile except by permit issued by the director of fish andwildlife under RCW 77.32.237. (3) Any person violating this section is guilty of a grossmisdemeanor.
